title: Acute appendicitis (India)
ref: ICMR STW, July 2022, sections Symptoms, Signs, Investigations, Treatment, Late presentation, Ochsner-Sherren regimen, Recurrent appendicitis
new: Leucocytosis with raised polymorphs supports appendicitis, but a normal count does not exclude it: combine with clinical scoring and imaging, and do not delay surgical referral for it (ICMR STW).

title: Acute appendicitis (India)
normal: Glucose 70–140 mg/dL; creatinine 0.6–1.2 mg/dL; haemoglobin 12–17 g/dL
ref: ICMR STW, July 2022, sections Symptoms, Signs, Investigations, Treatment, Late presentation, Ochsner-Sherren regimen, Recurrent appendicitis
new: Hyperglycaemia, renal impairment or anaemia should be optimised before anaesthesia where time allows; do not delay emergency surgery for them (ICMR STW).

title: Acute encephalitis syndrome in children (India)
test: Blood count, liver and kidney function, electrolytes
new: Thrombocytopenia suggests dengue or scrub typhus; hyponatraemia needs fluid correction; raised creatinine guides drug dosing. Use the pattern to choose empirical treatment (ICMR STW).

title: Acute encephalitis syndrome in children (India)
find: Pleocytosis, raised protein, low glucose in bacterial or TB infection
normal: Cells under 5/mm³; protein 15–45 mg/dL; glucose over 60% of blood
new: Raised cells and protein point to infection or inflammation of the brain; low glucose points to bacterial or tuberculous meningitis: start the matching treatment. Do it unless raised intracranial pressure, shock or coagulopathy contraindicates (ICMR STW).

title: Acute encephalitis syndrome in children (India)
new: Seizure activity means non-convulsive seizures or status: treat; diffuse slowing supports encephalopathy. Order when consciousness stays impaired or seizures are suspected (ICMR STW).

title: Acute kidney injury (India)
rat: If present, rule out glomerulonephritis (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, July 2026, section Desirable actions
new: Proteinuria or haematuria suggests glomerular disease: request urine protein-creatinine ratio, urine microscopy and nephrology review; a bland urine points towards pre-renal or tubular causes (ICMR STW).

title: Acute stroke (India)
new: A raised troponin may point to a cardiac cause or complication (infarction, arrhythmia): record an ECG and involve cardiology; it must not delay brain imaging or thrombolysis (ICMR STW).

title: Acute stroke (India)
new: Abnormal sodium or glucose can mimic or worsen stroke: correct them alongside the thrombolysis decision; a raised creatinine guides contrast use and drug dosing (ICMR STW).

title: Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (India)
new: Group and cross-match before any transfusion; keep matched units ready for a patient with ongoing bleeding or instability (ICMR STW).

title: Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (India)
find: Raised urea out of proportion to creatinine
new: Urea raised out of proportion to creatinine supports an upper gastrointestinal source; a raised creatinine suggests hypovolaemia or kidney injury: resuscitate and monitor (ICMR STW).

title: Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (India)
test: Liver function tests, HBsAg and anti-HCV
find: Raised bilirubin, low albumin, positive viral markers
normal: Bilirubin below 1.2 mg/dL; albumin 3.5–5 g/dL; viral markers negative
rat: Desirable tests pointing to cirrhosis (ICMR STW).
new: Raised bilirubin, low albumin or positive viral markers point to cirrhosis: manage as possible variceal bleeding (antibiotic prophylaxis, vasoactive drug) and treat the viral cause later (ICMR STW).

title: Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (India)
rat: Essential test; suggests liver disease (ICMR STW).
new: Low platelets or a raised INR suggest chronic liver disease and higher bleeding risk: consider variceal bleeding, give vitamin K for a raised INR and follow transfusion thresholds. Check in every patient (ICMR STW).

title: Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (India)
new: A raised count suggests infection (including spontaneous bacterial peritonitis in cirrhosis): look for the source and treat; a low count with low platelets suggests hypersplenism from liver disease (ICMR STW).

title: Alcohol withdrawal (India)
new: Macrocytosis, anaemia or low platelets suggest chronic heavy drinking or liver disease with nutritional deficiency; low counts raise bleeding and infection risk. Give thiamine and folate and treat the cause.

title: Antenatal care for normal pregnancy (India)
rat: Essential at the first visit (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, December 2025, section First visit
new: Rh negative: record it, check the partner's group, give anti-D at the schedule your unit follows and refer. Record the group at the first visit (ICMR STW).

title: Antenatal care for normal pregnancy (India)
find: Below 11 g/dL (two IFA daily); below 9 (iron sucrose); below 7 (refer)
ref: ICMR STW, December 2025, sections First visit and Third and fourth visits
new: Below 11 g/dL: two iron-folic acid tablets daily; below 9: iron sucrose; below 7: refer for transfusion decision. Repeat at every visit (ICMR STW).

title: Anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder (India)
new: Glucose below 70 mg/dL during symptoms means hypoglycaemia is causing the episodes: treat it and review diabetes drugs or diet before diagnosing an anxiety disorder (ICMR STW).

title: Anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder (India)
find: Duration, distress and impairment confirm disorder
new: Symptoms that last, cause distress and impair function confirm a disorder: rate severity, assess suicide risk and decide between psychological therapy and medicine (ICMR STW).

title: Anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder (India)
test: Plasma or urine metanephrines (if paroxysmal hypertension)
new: A raised level suggests phaeochromocytoma: refer to endocrinology for imaging and alpha-blockade before treating as anxiety. Send only with paroxysmal hypertension (ICMR STW).

title: Anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder (India)
test: Screen for depression, alcohol and substance misuse
find: Depressive symptoms; alcohol or substance misuse
new: A positive screen means co-existing depression, alcohol or substance misuse: treat it together with the anxiety, as it changes treatment choice and risk (ICMR STW).

title: Anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder (India)
new: A suppressed TSH suggests hyperthyroidism as the cause of the anxiety: treat it and reassess before starting anxiety treatment (ICMR STW).

title: Bradyarrhythmia and heart block (India)
find: Complete heart block, Mobitz II, pauses over 3 seconds
new: Complete heart block, Mobitz II or pauses over 3 seconds carry a high risk of asystole: treat as unstable even if the patient looks well, give atropine and prepare pacing. Record it first in every patient with bradycardia, including at PHC level (ICMR STW).

title: Bradyarrhythmia and heart block (India)
new: Pauses that match symptoms confirm a bradyarrhythmia that needs pacing; no pauses despite symptoms may need a longer recording. Use for intermittent symptoms with a normal resting ECG (ICMR STW).

title: Bradyarrhythmia and heart block (India)
new: Potassium above 6 mEq/L: give calcium gluconate and treat hyperkalaemia first, as it can cause the block; raised urea and creatinine point to a renal cause; low glucose needs correction (ICMR STW).

title: Bradyarrhythmia and heart block (India)
new: A raised TSH means hypothyroidism, a reversible cause of bradycardia: start levothyroxine and reassess before deciding on a pacemaker (ICMR STW).

title: Burns: initial assessment and fluid resuscitation (India)
test: Carboxyhaemoglobin and blood gas with lactate
ref: DGHS STG, 2025, Chapter 5, section Inhalation injury, pages 38–41
new: Raised carboxyhaemoglobin means carbon monoxide poisoning: give 100% oxygen until it falls; lactate above 2 mmol/L signals tissue hypoperfusion or cyanide: escalate resuscitation. Send after enclosed-space fires (DGHS STG).

title: Burns: initial assessment and fluid resuscitation (India)
ref: DGHS STG, 2025, Chapter 5, section Electrical burns
new: Arrhythmia or ischaemic change needs continuous cardiac monitoring and admission. Record an ECG after any electrical injury (DGHS STG).

title: Chikungunya (India)
new: Recommended in neonates because myocarditis can occur: myocardial dysfunction or effusion needs paediatric cardiology and supportive care. Order for poor feeding, tachycardia, a murmur or shock.

title: Chronic hepatitis B (India)
find: 8.0 kPa or more (fibrosis); 12.5 kPa or more (cirrhosis)
new: 8.0 kPa or more suggests significant fibrosis and 12.5 kPa or more suggests cirrhosis: both support starting antiviral treatment and cirrhosis surveillance. Use where available (NVHCP p. 22).

title: Delirium in adults (India)
new: Stop or taper anticholinergics, opioids and benzodiazepines where safe; they commonly cause delirium. Review on admission and daily (NICE 1.4).

title: Dementia (India)
test: Computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) brain
new: Subdural collection, tumour, hydrocephalus or infarcts are structural causes that change management: refer. Age-appropriate atrophy alone does not exclude dementia. Available at district level (ICMR STW).

title: Dementia (India)
new: A reactive result means HIV-associated cognitive disorder is possible and treatable: refer to the ART centre. Test with counselling when suspicion is high (ICMR STW).

title: Dementia (India)
new: Domain-specific deficits separate dementia types and distinguish dementia from depression. Refer to a tertiary centre when the diagnosis is unclear or onset is young (ICMR STW).

title: Dementia (India)
test: Thyroid function, vitamin B12, VDRL, blood count, biochemistry, liver tests, lipids, vitamin D
new: Hypothyroidism, low vitamin B12 or reactive VDRL are reversible causes: treat and reassess cognition. Do at PHC level before diagnosing dementia (ICMR STW).

title: Depression and suicide-risk assessment (India)
new: Low haemoglobin (anaemia) can cause fatigue and low mood: investigate and treat the cause before attributing symptoms to depression alone (ICMR STW).

title: Epilepsy and status epilepticus (India)
rat: Part of status epilepticus monitoring (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, section Status epilepticus
new: Acidosis or hypoxia in status epilepticus: give oxygen, treat the cause and escalate to intensive care if pH stays low or breathing fails. Repeat after seizure control (ICMR STW).

title: Epilepsy and status epilepticus (India)
rat: Part of status epilepticus work-up (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, section Status epilepticus
new: A positive screen identifies drug-induced seizures or withdrawal: treat the cause and avoid drugs that lower the seizure threshold. Send in a first seizure or unexplained status (ICMR STW).

title: Essential newborn thermal care and hypothermia (India)
ref: ICMR STW, July 2020, section Warm chain: postnatal wards
new: Cold feet suggest cold stress and a cold trunk suggests hypothermia: warm with skin-to-skin contact and take the baby to a facility if it persists. Teach mothers to check (ICMR STW).

title: Febrile seizures (India)
test: Clinical examination for fever source and meningism
normal: Focus such as otitis; no meningism
ref: IAP COPP module, 2017, section Laboratory investigations
new: Neck stiffness or a bulging fontanelle means possible meningitis: investigate and treat per protocol. A focus such as otitis explains the fever. Examine every child (IAP).

title: Fever in children: approach (India)
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, section Fever without focus
new: A raised value makes bacterial infection more likely and supports starting antibiotics; a low value does not exclude it. Use in fever without focus when the child looks unwell (ICMR STW).

title: Fever in children: approach (India)
rat: Consider in fever without focus (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, section Fever without focus
new: Consolidation means pneumonia: treat. Order for fever without a focus when there is cough, fast breathing or low oxygen saturation (ICMR STW).

title: Fever in children: approach (India)
rat: Consider in fever without focus (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, section Fever without focus
new: Pyuria or significant growth means urinary tract infection: treat and image the urinary tract according to age. Send before antibiotics when the fever has no source (ICMR STW).

title: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (India)
find: Reactive: manage as HIV infection, not PEP
ref: CDC nPEP guideline update, 2025, Appendix A, Laboratory testing recommendation 2
new: Reactive: manage as HIV infection, not PEP. Non-reactive: start PEP as soon as possible, within 72 hours of exposure (CDC 2025).

title: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (India)
test: Hepatitis B surface antigen and anti-HBs; hepatitis C antibody
ref: CDC nPEP guideline update, 2025, Appendix A, Laboratory testing recommendations 6–7
new: Positive HBsAg or HCV antibody: refer for hepatology assessment. Non-protective anti-HBs: give hepatitis B vaccine. None of these delays PEP (CDC 2025).

title: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (India)
ref: CDC nPEP guideline update, 2025, Appendix A, Laboratory testing recommendation 6
new: Positive: PEP is still indicated; counsel and choose a pregnancy-compatible regimen. Negative: advise contraception during PEP (CDC 2025).

title: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (India)
test: Serum creatinine and creatinine clearance; ALT and AST
find: CrCl below 50 mL/min: TLD not recommended
normal: CrCl 50 mL/min or more; normal transaminases
ref: WHO Prequalification, HA737 part 4, section 4.2 Renal impairment
new: Creatinine clearance below 50 mL/min: TLD is not recommended, so choose a renally adjusted regimen. Raised ALT or AST: review the regimen with a specialist. Do not delay the first dose for results (CDC 2025; label).

title: Heart failure (India)
rat: Desirable test supporting the diagnosis (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, section Desirable investigations
new: A raised value supports heart failure; a normal value makes it unlikely in an untreated patient. Use when the diagnosis is uncertain, and read it with age and kidney function (ICMR STW).

title: Heart failure (India)
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, section Desirable investigations
new: Abnormal TSH (high or low) can cause or worsen heart failure: treat the thyroid disorder and reassess heart function (ICMR STW).

title: Heavy menstrual bleeding (India)
test: Bleeding time, clotting time, liver and kidney function, blood group
ref: ICMR STW, December 2025, sections History and examination, Investigations, Endometrial thickness pathway, Acute heavy bleeding, Medical treatment, Surgical options, Referral
new: Prolonged bleeding or clotting times, or abnormal liver function, suggest a bleeding disorder or liver disease: refer for coagulation work-up before hormonal or surgical treatment. Know the blood group before any surgery (ICMR STW).

title: Hypothyroidism (India)
rat: First-line test for primary hypothyroidism (ICMR STW).
new: A raised TSH confirms primary hypothyroidism: with a low free T4 start levothyroxine and recheck TSH after 6-8 weeks to adjust the dose (ICMR STW).

title: Insulin initiation and titration (India)
new: Lumps (lipohypertrophy) make insulin absorption erratic: rotate sites, never inject into lumps and recheck at every visit; unexplained high glucose may improve after changing site (ICMR T1DM).

title: Insulin initiation and titration (India)
ref: ICMR STW, July 2022, section Sick-day rules
new: Positive ketones with glucose above 250 mg/dL on a sick day: take extra rapid-acting insulin per sick-day rules, drink fluids, and seek urgent care if vomiting or ketones stay high (ketoacidosis risk) (ICMR T1DM).

title: Neonatal seizures (India)
new: Pleocytosis or low glucose means meningitis: start meningitis-dose antibiotics. Do it when sepsis is suspected and the baby is stable enough (ICMR STW).

title: Pharyngitis and sore throat (India)
test: Haemogram with differential and peripheral smear
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, sections Causes, Centor criteria, Red flags, Investigations, Management at PHC, District hospital, Tonsillectomy indications
new: Atypical lymphocytes suggest infectious mononucleosis (avoid amoxicillin); very low neutrophils suggest agranulocytosis or severe viral illness: urgent review (ICMR STW).

title: Pharyngitis and sore throat (India)
test: Tests for Epstein-Barr virus, herpes, fungal or gonococcal infection
ref: ICMR STW, October 2019, sections Causes, Centor criteria, Red flags, Investigations, Management at PHC, District hospital, Tonsillectomy indications
new: A positive result identifies a non-streptococcal cause and changes treatment (antiviral, antifungal or gonococcal therapy). Send only when the throat picture is atypical (ICMR STW).

title: Preterm labour and preterm prelabour rupture of membranes (India)
new: Above 50 ng/mL: treat as preterm labour (steroids, magnesium sulfate, transfer); 50 or less: preterm birth is unlikely, so avoid unnecessary intervention. Use only if cervical length cannot be measured (NICE 1.7.5).

title: Rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease (India)
ref: ICMR STW, July 2024, page 1 (pathophysiology, clinical features, Jones criteria table, laboratory investigations, differential diagnosis)
new: A raised white count supports an acute inflammatory or infective process in rheumatic fever; read it with ESR and CRP and never diagnose from it alone. A normal count does not exclude it (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
rat: Desirable; adjust antibiotics to sensitivity (ICMR STW).
new: A pathogen growing confirms the cause; use the sensitivities to narrow antibiotics. Send before the first antibiotic dose without delaying it (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
new: Hypoglycaemia needs immediate IV dextrose; hyponatraemia guides fluid choice and seizure risk. Check at presentation and after fluid boluses (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
new: A raised CRP supports bacterial infection, but a normal value early does not exclude sepsis: never delay antibiotics for the result. Repeat to judge response (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
find: Turbid; raised cells and protein, low glucose
rat: Desirable when meningitis is suspected (ICMR STW).
new: Turbid fluid, raised cells and protein or low glucose means bacterial meningitis: give meningitis-dose antibiotics. Do not perform a lumbar puncture in a shocked child, with raised intracranial pressure signs or a coagulopathy; treat first (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
new: Consolidation or effusion points to pneumonia as the source: treat it, and look for empyema if the child does not improve. Order when there are chest signs (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
test: Complete blood count and peripheral smear
find: Leucocytosis or leucopenia; parasites; low platelets
new: Leucocytosis or leucopenia supports sepsis; parasites on the smear mean malaria (treat at once); low platelets suggest dengue or sepsis-related coagulopathy and need monitoring. Repeat if the child worsens (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
normal: Creatinine 0.2–0.5 mg/dL (young child); ALT below 40 U/L
new: Raised creatinine means acute kidney injury: adjust drug doses and avoid nephrotoxins; raised transaminases suggest hepatic dysfunction: reassess dosing and consider higher-level care (ICMR STW).

title: Sepsis and septic shock in children (India)
new: Pyuria suggests a urinary tract infection as the source: send culture and make sure antibiotics cover it (ICMR STW).

title: Sickle cell disease (India)
normal: Creatinine 60–110 µmol/L; alanine aminotransferase under 40 U/L
new: Record the baseline before hydroxyurea; if creatinine or transaminases are raised, reduce the dose or defer and repeat. Recheck periodically on treatment.

title: Skin and soft-tissue infections: cellulitis, abscess and impetigo (India)
rat: Desirable; guides change of antibiotic (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, July 2022, sections General principles, Impetigo, Folliculitis, Furuncle, Carbuncle, Abscess, Cellulitis, Erysipelas, SSSS, Investigations, Sepsis red flags, Suspect MRSA, Topical, Oral, MRSA options
new: Staphylococcus aureus (including MRSA) or streptococci guides antibiotic change: switch to MRSA cover if MRSA grows or the patient fails to respond. Send pus from an abscess (ICMR STW).

title: Stable angina and chronic coronary syndrome (India)
find: Q waves, ST-T changes, bundle branch block or chamber enlargement
normal: Normal sinus rhythm, no Q waves or ST-T changes
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, sections Definitions, Symptoms, Investigations, Drugs and doses, Management by level of care, Risk categories, Revascularisation
new: A normal resting ECG does not exclude coronary disease. Q waves or ST-T changes suggest past infarction or ischaemia and support further testing; bundle branch block or chamber enlargement affects the choice of stress test. Compare with old tracings (ICMR STW).

title: Stable angina and chronic coronary syndrome (India)
test: Haemogram, urea, creatinine, electrolytes, sugar, lipids
normal: Haemoglobin 13–17 g/dL (men); fasting glucose under 100 mg/dL; LDL cholesterol under 100 mg/dL
rat: Essential tests; treat contributing factors (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, sections Definitions, Symptoms, Investigations, Drugs and doses, Management by level of care, Risk categories, Revascularisation
new: Anaemia, diabetes or dyslipidaemia make angina worse: correct anaemia, treat diabetes and start a statin. Check at the first assessment (ICMR STW).

title: Stable angina and chronic coronary syndrome (India)
normal: Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) 0.4–4.0 mIU/L; glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) under 5.7%
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, sections Definitions, Symptoms, Investigations, Drugs and doses, Management by level of care, Risk categories, Revascularisation
new: A suppressed TSH suggests thyrotoxicosis aggravating angina: treat it. HbA1c 6.5% or more means diabetes: start diabetes care, as it raises cardiovascular risk (ICMR STW).

title: Traumatic brain injury (India)
test: Blood glucose, electrolytes, blood count, coagulation, group and cross-match
new: Hypoglycaemia or hyponatraemia can worsen brain injury: correct them. Coagulopathy needs reversal before surgery; keep matched blood ready.

title: Type 2 diabetes (India adaptation, Asian BMI cut-offs)
rat: Part of the annual check-up (ICMR 2018, p. 15).
new: LDL above target means start or intensify a statin; ischaemic changes mean cardiology review before exercise advice. Repeat yearly (ICMR 2018, p. 15).

title: Unstable angina and NSTEMI (India)
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, section Essential investigations
new: Pulmonary oedema means acute heart failure: give a diuretic and oxygen if hypoxic and escalate. Other findings (widened mediastinum, pneumothorax) point to another diagnosis (ICMR STW).

title: Unstable angina and NSTEMI (India)
rat: Essential investigations for secondary prevention (ICMR STW).
ref: ICMR STW, January 2026, section Essential investigations
new: Diabetes or a raised LDL needs treatment as part of secondary prevention (diabetes care, high-intensity statin). Check in every patient (ICMR STW).

title: Urticaria and angioedema (India)
new: Vasculitis on biopsy means urticarial vasculitis: refer to dermatology or rheumatology. Biopsy only if wheals last over 24 hours or leave bruising (ICMR STW).

title: Varicella (chickenpox) and herpes zoster (India)
test: Tzanck smear or PCR of vesicle fluid
new: Multinucleated giant cells or VZV DNA confirm a herpes-group virus (VZV by PCR). Send when the rash is atypical or the patient is immunocompromised, and start antivirals without waiting (ICMR STW).
